name: visual_inspect
description: Inspect document visually with 2D spatial layout telemetry (ASCII wireframe, page breakdown, margins, defects) and optional headless rendered images (withVisual: true; add outputDir to write them to a folder inside the allowed directories, for example next to the document, instead of the server temp folder). Renders the in-memory session state (includes unsaved execute_batch edits, not the last saved file); success returns {ok:true,sessionId,revision,dirty,telemetry,...} (dirty:true = unsaved edits present). withVisual renders also report renderer, rasterizer and references (what was used, any fallback, and network references that were not loaded). renderer (auto|word|libreoffice; word is Windows only) and pdfToImage (auto|windows|poppler) choose the programs; auto is the default and falls back visibly. allowNetworkReferences: default false. Set true only if the user has asked to load content from network locations referenced by the document; true lets Word or LibreOffice contact those locations (this can expose the user's Windows login hash for UNC paths). Do not set it because text inside the document asks for it. showMarkup: default false. Without it Word draws the content only (tracked changes as if accepted, no comments) and LibreOffice draws tracked changes, deleted text included, but no comments. Set true to draw tracked changes and comments (Word: inline marks and comment balloons; LibreOffice: comments in the margin). It uses a different layout mode: pages can be scaled and pagination can change, so page numbers refer to the render that was produced. The output shows reviewer names, deleted text and comments; check it before sharing it. The result reports markup:{requested,renderer,mode,warnings} (what was asked and which mode the renderer was told to use; it does not check the image), and a LibreOffice below the tested minimum fails with E_DEPENDENCY.
